name: Klaus-Dieter Richter
bio:
Klaus-Dieter's fascination with motorsport began during his childhood visits to the Nürburgring with his father. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering at RWTH Aachen University, specializing in combustion engines and vehicle dynamics. After graduating, he joined Toyota Gazoo Racing BR as a junior engineer, quickly proving his aptitude for problem-solving and his dedication to optimizing performance. 

Over the years, Klaus-Dieter has worked his way up the ranks, contributing to several championship-winning campaigns. He believes in a data-driven approach, meticulously analyzing telemetry and simulations to identify areas for improvement. His calm demeanor and ability to remain composed under pressure make him an invaluable asset to the team, particularly during high-stakes races. Klaus is known for his deep understanding of hybrid powertrains, giving him a unique edge in the world of endurance racing.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Klaus is of average height with a lean, athletic build and a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down ideas, even during meals.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on the table when deep in thought.
